prompt: The new city park plan (to talk about) at the town hall meeting.
explanation_ru: Предложный глагол talk about в пассивном залоге сохраняет предлог about после причастия: was talked about.

prompt: Anna smiled when a free box of fresh apples (to give) to her at the food store.
explanation_ru: Когда прямым подлежащим становится сам предмет (a free box of fresh apples), в Past Simple Passive используется форма was given.

prompt: Great news for new customers: a free paper calendar was sent me by the friendly bank.

accepted_answers: Great news for new customers: I was sent a free paper calendar by the friendly bank.
Great news for new customers: a free paper calendar was sent to me by the friendly bank.

prompt: I called the station office, and my lost bag report (to look into) by the staff right now.

prompt: Heavy snow blocked the railway tracks, so the morning express train (to call off).

prompt: Good news for you: the noisy street problem ___ by the kind people next door.

prompt: We felt upset because the evening theatre show (to put off) due to heavy rain.

prompt: Several exciting local stories (to bring up) by the museum guide during the class tour.

prompt: The signed receipt ___ to the sender as soon as the box reaches the door.

prompt: The online store (to turn down) three late return requests because the tags were missing.
